description.p: Meridian is an offline music player that places your library on a mood map (Shadow↔Glow / Still↔Kinetic) and builds a context-aware listen queue from where you are on the map.
Import local folders, analyze tracks without an account, and browse by mood instead of only by folder or playlist.

AppImage refresh (still 1.3.6): louder-normalized short listens, audible-span windows, shape/timbre/steer for the queue, placement honesty cues (dialogue drop, tonal×onset blend, pitch Glow, pulse Kinetic, keyword undo, sub-bass Shadow), kept-prior mass re-queue bug fix, plus earlier path-to-9 blend and dual-worker analyze.

More honest offline mood placement, dual-window acoustic cues, smarter local recommendations (matrix-first context queue gap-fill so SHELF no longer crowds out NOW/DEEP/FILL), AppImage desktop install, and reliability fixes for BPM/signal trust, library scan, matrix / context queue, crossfade credit, safer quit, and mood-map interaction.
